item.title: playwright 1.65.0
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a minor release Quote: …and [apiRequestContext.cookies()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-apirequestcontext#api-request-context-cookies) no longer return host-only cookies for subdomains or `Path=/api` cookies for `/apiv2`, and a `Path=/foo/` cookie does not match `/foo`.… Quote: - Proxy credentials are no longer sent to websites. Quote: - Text that the browser does not render, such as text that is not assigned to a slot or text directly inside a closed `<details>`, is no longer part of accessible names and aria snapshots. Release notes: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/releases/tag/v1.65.0
